verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents headless, non-interactive runs for workflow automation with structured JSON output. It also ships GitHub-based automations, automated PR reviews and issue triage, that run without a user present, and a community report corroborates the PR-review automation in practice. These automations are tied to scripts and GitHub events; the CLI itself offers no evidenced way to create, schedule or manage recurring background jobs. Missing for 10: built-in recurring scheduling or background job runner, management or monitoring of running automations, depth of documentation on configuring autonomous runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
